Overview
Anyone with even a passing interest in cars (and quite a few with none whatsoever come to think of it) will be well aware of Renault's impressive history when it comes to sporty little hatchbacks. The Renault 5 Alpine was a defining model back in the '70s and the subsequent Renault 5 Turbo in the '80s was even more significant. Then it was the turn of the humble Clio to get a bit of a tickle in the performance department with the brilliant Williams edition in '93, and souped-up Clios would continue to be offered by the French manufacturer for decades, with the Clio RS 182 from 2005 arguably being one of the best of an already impressive bunch .
Developed by Renaultsport, Renault's high performance division, and following on from the 172, there were actually three versions of the Clio RS 182: the standard 182, the more race-focussed 182 Cup and the limited edition 182 Trophy. With only 500 ever made the Trophy got the full package, including a suitably imposing rear spoiler borrowed from the Clio V6, Recaro racing seats, uprated (and incredibly expensive) Sachs suspension with remote reservoirs and 16” Speedline Turini wheels. Combined with the car's 180bhp, 2.0-litre naturally aspirated inline-four cylinder engine and short-ratio five-speed manual transmission the 182 Trophy is hailed by many as one of the greatest hot hatches ever made and has rightly earned its reputation as a yardstick by which all others are measured.
This particular model, number 169 of the aforementioned 500, was supplied new by Masters Renault of Shirley in Surrey on the 6th of August 2005 and has remained with its first and only private owner ever since. Having covered just over 10K miles in total the car is incredibly well-preserved and presents in excellent condition throughout.
This example’s distinction lies further in its originality and care. The specification is untouched and wholly original and in 2022 the car benefited from a comprehensive service, including a replacement cam belt, ensuring an impressive level of mechanical integrity. Clearly cherished and well-maintained from the off, this Clio RS 182 Trophy is a stunning representation of a rare, iconic and hugely rewarding hatchback from a time when pure, analogue driver's cars were still very much celebrated before everything got a bit too digital.

Summary
A benchmark for what a hot hatch should be, the Renaultsport Clio 182 Trophy is a beautifully balanced, analogue and driver-focussed masterclass of the genre that remains as compelling today as it did 20 years ago. You'll be hard pressed to find another with such low miles and in such good condition so snap this up now while you have the chance. Not only will you be the proud owner of one of Renault's best but it also makes sense as an investment piece. It truly is a win-win situation.
